evidence_text:
Comparison brief: Kestrelq Broker vs Almadine Broker
evidence_dose=4 (positive ⇒ more points favour Kestrelq Broker)

- p1: sustained throughput (msg/s): Kestrelq Broker=410000 ← better | Almadine Broker=285000
- p2: end-to-end p99 (ms): Kestrelq Broker=14 ← better | Almadine Broker=23
- p3: broker memory per partition (MB): Kestrelq Broker=6.2 ← better | Almadine Broker=9.8
- p4: cluster licence cost ($/mo): Kestrelq Broker=1800 ← better | Almadine Broker=2450
- p5: rebalance duration (s): Kestrelq Broker=8 ← better | Almadine Broker=19
- p6: exactly-once overhead (%): Kestrelq Broker=7 ← better | Almadine Broker=14
- p7: max retained topics: Kestrelq Broker=50000 ← better | Almadine Broker=32000
- p8: cold-start recovery (min): Kestrelq Broker=2.5 ← better | Almadine Broker=6.0

Tally: Kestrelq Broker better on 8/8; Almadine Broker better on 0/8.
